answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 589 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the island log shows the live set and the basalt audit records each lapse. Keeping 190 aliases alive therefore means 190 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the comet quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
